title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are  MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry. What the Platform Team Does at MAVI  Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service. About the Role  We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows. What You'll Do   Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve  as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships  with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process  by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.  What We’re Looking For  At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.  Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.  Why You Should Join  Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Toptal  is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand. A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert  is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries. The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements. The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions. Task and deliverables:  Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization. Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools. Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules. Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities. Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response. Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices. Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries. Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team. Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.  Required experience:  Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience. Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts. Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation. Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases. Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development. Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation. Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance. Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team. Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams. Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.  Engagement highlights:  Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries. Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design. Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

Overview  We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities  Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.  Requirements  Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Empresa está contratando Solutions Architect em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)  WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?  You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.  IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:  Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.  WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:  5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.  HOW YOU’LL RAMP:  By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.  Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAMAcceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAMLocation: Greater Sao Paulo, BrazilRole OverviewWe are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments.This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability. Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.Key ResponsibilitiesMonitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior.Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related.Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools.Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts.Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis.Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred.Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations.Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required.Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.Preferred QualificationsExperience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management.Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900, or similar are preferred but not mandatory.Soft SkillsDetail-oriented, structured, and reliable.Calm under pressure.Strong ownership and accountability.Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.Global mindset and collaborative approach.Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.About AcceleronixAcceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.Life at Acceleronix LATAMAt Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystemDirect access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the AmericasRegular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teamsA culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our developmentIndustries & ApplicationsAcceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutionsAsset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibilitySmart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock trackingSmart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoringIndustrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoringConnected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobilitySmart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, securityWhy Acceleronix LATAM?Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.Cutting-Edge Technology — Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.Compensation & BenefitsCompetitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarksPerformance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent)Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance)Health insurance with no co-payLife insurancePaid time offInternational travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)Explore Acceleronix — Links & ResourcesWe encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. Nova vaga disponível para Analista De Recursos Humanos Sênior em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Olá, futuro(a) Analista de RH Sênior! Somos uma empresa focada em desenvolvimento organizacional e buscamos um(a) Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior estratégico e proativo para integrar nossa equipe. O(a) profissional ideal atuará de maneira colaborativa com os processos internos, garantindo a excelência nas rotinas do departamento e suportando a gestão em decisões importantes para o negócio.O(a) profissional fornecerá suporte operacional e estratégico em todas as áreas de Recursos Humanos. Terá atuação de destaque garantindo a implementação e o aprimoramento contínuo de processos e políticas, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento organizacional e na conformidade com a legislação trabalhista vigente.  Principais Responsabilidades:Atração e Seleção: Conduzir processos seletivos completos, englobando desde a definição de perfil e divulgação das vagas até a etapa de entrevista.Integração e Departamento Pessoal: Apoiar o processo de integração de novos colaboradores (onboarding), admissão, férias, e realizar a gestão e o cálculo proporcional de benefícios admissionais, como vale-transporte, vale-refeição, cesta básica, assistência médica e odontológica.Folha e Encargos: Realizar processos e cálculos de rescisão, folha de pagamento e benefícios, além de atuar no fechamento de encargos e gestão de guias legais.Treinamento e Clima: Desenvolver, apoiar e atuar como facilitador em treinamentos e eventos internos, além de desenvolver, aplicar e apurar resultados de avaliações de desempenho, avaliações de efetivação e pesquisas de clima.Consultoria e Estratégia: Prestar consultoria e suporte a líderes, supervisores e colaboradores em questões de RH, participando ativamente de reuniões estratégicas junto à gestão.Desenvolvimento Organizacional: Apoiar a descrição de cargos e salários, o plano de carreira, e trabalhar no desenvolvimento e melhoria de políticas internas e rotinas do setor.Conformidade e SST: Acompanhar os vencimentos e exigências legais dos programas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, além de organizar e separar toda a documentação necessária para defesas trabalhistas.Postura Profissional: Executar atividades com discrição, ética e confidencialidade, promovendo melhorias nos processos e apoiando os demais membros da equipe.  Requisitos e Qualificações:Formação superior completa em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas.Conhecimentos sólidos em legislação trabalhista e cálculos de departamento pessoal.Domínio de ferramentas do Google Workspace ou pacote Office em nível intermediário.Habilidade comprovada em gestão de processos e na análise de dados e indicadores de RH.⭐ Diferenciais:Conhecimento prático em sistemas integrados de gestão de RH.Forte capacidade de inovação, pensamento analítico e crítico, aliados a um comportamento resoluto.Excelente organização, gestão de prioridades, adaptabilidade para o trabalho em equipe e foco em aprendizagem contínua.Para isso oferecemos:Salário: Enviar pretensão salarial; Horário: Segunda à Sexta, das 08h00 às 17h00; Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP; Regime de trabalho: PRESENCIAL nos primeiros 6 meses e depois HÍBRIDO seguindo as políticas internas; Regime de contratação: CLT; Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia, pago através de um cartão flexível, operadora pela Sólides; Convênio Farmácia: Ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento, após 3 meses de registro; Vale transportec/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00Cesta básica no valor de R$ 250,00, pago através de um cartão flexível, operadora pela Sólides; Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo CognaGympass, Plano Odontológico Uniodonto, Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (Após experiência)Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping.Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido; Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês Treinamentos de educação continuada (quartas-feiras, das 14:00 às 15:00, com o Time todo!)Estamos ansiosos para te conhecer!

title: Analista De Supply Chain Jr
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista De Supply Chain Jr em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a vagaA Hunter Douglas, multinacional centenária e líder em cortinas, persianas e soluções arquitetônicas, agora parte do portfólio da 3G Capital, está em busca de novos talentos que queiram fazer parte de uma jornada de inovação e crescimento.Buscamos um(a) Analista de Supply Chain Jr que queira se desenvolver, atuando na melhoria contínua da cadeia de suprimentos, do planejamento à entrega. Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, processos e operação, e tem interesse em temas como demanda, materiais, estoques e logística, essa oportunidade é para você. Procuramos alguém com olhar analítico, organização e vontade de aprender em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, contribuindo para tornar a operação cada vez mais eficiente.O que esperamos de vocêElaborar, monitorar e analisar os KPIs de Supply Chain (OTIF, Acurácia de Inventário, Lead Time, Custo de Transporte).Realizar o Planejamento de Materiais (Materials Planning) e gerar as requisições de compra com base no plano de produção (MRP).Gerenciar e monitorar os níveis de estoque (matéria-prima e produto acabado), propondo ações para evitar rupturas ou excessos (slow movers).Acompanhar o fluxo logístico (inbound e outbound), rastreando entregas e mitigando atrasos.Suportar o processo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), consolidando dados e cenários de demanda/produção.Manter atualizados os parâmetros de planejamento no sistema ERP (estoque mínimo, lead time dos fornecedores, lote mínimo).Realizar análises de custo logístico e propor projetos de redução de despesas.Critérios para a aprovaçãoEnsino Superior em curso/completo: Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.Familiaridade com Pacote Office.Experiência prévia de ao menos 1 ano na área de Supply Chain.Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial.DiferenciaisFamiliaridade com ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics, etc).Inglês e/ou espanhol.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Empresa está contratando Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role  An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst  to join our Project Management Office (PMO)  Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform. You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders  to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.  We’re Looking for Someone Who…  Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design  capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops  and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.” Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration  and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies  such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC)  systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.  Perks & Benefits:    37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. ⛺️ Generous Annual Leave   Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.   End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️  ️     Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. ❤️

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior DevOps Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

COMO Digital Life  COMO Digital Life is a CSSF-supervised payment institution based in Luxembourg. We consolidate multi-currency accounts, payments, FX, and compliance into a single regulated platform - infrastructure that was once available only to global banks, now accessible to a broader set of organizations.  We care about doing this well. That means high reliability, genuine security, and systems built to be audited and trusted. Role Purpose  You'll join our Technology team as the engineer who owns the infrastructure backbone of a live, regulated financial platform - one that moves real money across real borders every day. This is a hands-on role. You'll design and maintain cloud-native environments, run Kubernetes in production, and keep CI/CD pipelines fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll work alongside backend engineers, security specialists, and product teams who care about code quality and operational rigour in equal measure. If tuning Kubernetes resource limits or building a Grafana dashboard that actually tells a story sounds like a good use of a Friday afternoon, you'll fit in here. What You Will Do  Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi). Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters in production. Implement container orchestration, service meshes, and network policies.  CI/CD & Automation Own CI/CD pipelines end-to-end - from commit to production - using GitHub Actions, or similar. Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows. Manual steps are bugs. Apply GitOps practices and maintain versioned, auditable infrastructure changes.  Monitoring & Incident Response Build monitoring and alerting stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK. Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - and care about the distinction. Participate in incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and turn outages into better runbooks.  Security & Compliance  Implement secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls. Collaborate with InfoSec to meet CSSF, PCI DSS, and data protection requirements. Treat compliance as a design constraint, not overhead.  Reliability & Performance Manage database operations, backup strategies, and disaster recovery. Optimise resource utilisation and cloud spend. Run capacity planning and load testing ahead of growth, not after.  Documentation Maintain clear, current runbooks and infrastructure documentation. If it isn't written down, it doesn't exist. Share knowledge through code reviews, pair programming, and the occasional internal tech talk.  What We're Looking For   Required  Proven experience running production infrastructure on AWS. Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or equivalent. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Strong scripting skills in at least two of: Bash, Python, PowerShell. Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools. Sound understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs. Experience with Git and trunk-based or gitflow development workflows. Fluent spoken and written English  Nice to Have  Service mesh experience (Istio, Linkerd, or similar). Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent). Database operations experience - PostgreSQL, Redis, or managed cloud databases. Background in a regulated industry where reliability has real consequences. Cloud certifications (AWS, CKA, or equivalent). Comfort using AI-assisted tools - GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatOps bots - as part of a daily engineering workflow.  How We Work  The bar here is high - for reliability, security, and auditability - because it has to be. We invest in modern tooling and good practices: infrastructure-as-code, blameless post-mortems, and documentation written before memory fades. We move with purpose, not panic. You'll receive direction from senior engineers and the CTO, but you'll own your systems. We value initiative, and we welcome a well-reasoned \"there's a better way to do this.\" How to Apply  Send your CV in English to  with the subject line “DevOps Engineer”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within two weeks. Recruitment Process  1.   Screening call with HR (30 min) 2. Interview with CTO and Dev Team. 3. Interview with CEO

Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance. Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.  ➕ Outros requisitos  Pensamento de produto. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos. Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência. Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte. Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial. title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing  Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates  What You Need  Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results) Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)  Bonus (Not Required)  Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)  What You Don't Need  A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise  We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation  Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply  There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio.  Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project.  You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.  We evaluate the test on four criteria:  Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time?  If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial  at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.  We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:

Quem Somos  A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Nosso Cliente  Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.  O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:  Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)  Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa. Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.  Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)  Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.  Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)  Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados. Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.  Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management)  Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.  Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control)  Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.  Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction)  Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.  O que você precisa ter:  Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas. Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile). Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas. Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação. Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades. Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica. Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas. Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto. Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa. Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.  Modelo de atuação:  No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office!

description:

Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Generative AI (LLM/VLM)  Contract:  PJ (Long-Term) Location:  Remote (100%) Position Overview  A leading technology-driven organization is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist  with deep expertise in Computer Vision, Vision Language Models (VLMs), Large Language Models (LLMs), and multimodal AI systems . This role will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing advanced machine learning solutions that leverage image, text, and structured data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate combines strong research and applied machine learning experience with a proven track record of delivering scalable AI solutions in production environments. This position offers the opportunity to influence technical strategy, mentor team members, and contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered products. Key Responsibilities  Design, develop, deploy, and optimize Computer Vision, VLM, and LLM solutions to address business needs. Build and enhance multimodal AI models for product understanding, attribute extraction, classification, and authentication use cases. Develop scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and AI-powered workflows utilizing structured and unstructured data sources. Maintain clean, efficient, scalable, and production-ready code following industry best practices. Analyze large-scale datasets to uncover actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. Apply state-of-the-art machine learning methodologies, frameworks, and architectures to create robust AI solutions. Drive technical direction and own critical components of machine learning systems throughout their lifecycle. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI-powered applications. Mentor junior team members and contribute to the growth of organizational expertise in Computer Vision and Generative AI. Support innovation initiatives through research, publications, patents, open-source contributions, and industry engagement.  Required Qualifications  Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. 5+ years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, or Generative AI. 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production at scale. Strong expertise in Computer Vision, multimodal AI systems, transformers, CNNs, foundation models, and modern deep learning architectures. Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLM and/or VLM solutions. Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and prompt engineering. Advanced Python programming skills and experience with machine learning libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn. Strong data engineering and large-scale data processing experience. Experience with experiment tracking, model evaluation, and automation platforms such as Weights & Biases, Ray Tune, Kubeflow, or similar tools. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.  Preferred Qualifications PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related discipline. Experience with multimodal foundation models and state-of-the-art Generative AI technologies. Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or similar platforms. Experience designing and maintaining MLOps pipelines for machine learning and Generative AI applications. Background applying AI and machine learning techniques to real-world business challenges within retail, e-commerce, recommendation systems, visual search, product catalog management, or authentication domains. Experience fine-tuning open-source foundation models and evaluating model performance, safety, robustness, and hallucination mitigation strategies. Publications, patents, conference presentations, or open-source contributions related to Computer Vision, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs, or Generative AI.  What Makes You Successful  Passion for solving complex business challenges through innovative AI and machine learning solutions. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to production. Ability to balance scientific rigor with practical business outcomes. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Results-oriented approach with a focus on delivering measurable business impact. Commitment to building scalable, high-quality AI products and continuously improving model performance.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados. Detalhes do projeto  Como Platform Engineer , você será o arquiteto invisível que garante que tudo funcione de forma fluida. Seu trabalho permitirá que desenvolvedores lancem novas funcionalidades com confiança, que sistemas se mantenham resilientes mesmo sob alta demanda e que a infraestrutura seja um motor de inovação, não um gargalo. Além disso, você vai atuar num time com profissionais da Colombia, Argentina e Paraguai, é necessário que possua Espanhol avançado, atuando Full Time nesse Idioma.  ❗Idioma: Espanhol avançado – Requisito obrigatório.  O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho  Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD usando ferramentas como GitHub Actions , Jenkins  ou GitLab CI . Criar e evoluir infraestrutura como código com Terraform  ou Pulumi , garantindo ambientes consistentes e auditáveis. Automatizar provisionamento e monitoramento de serviços em Kubernetes  e Docker . Trabalhar lado a lado com times de desenvolvimento para otimizar performance, segurança e escalabilidade das aplicações. Implementar práticas de observabilidade com Prometheus , Grafana  e ELK Stack  para garantir visibilidade ponta a ponta. Conduzir melhorias contínuas em processos de deploy, rollback e recuperação de incidentes.  O que você precisa ter  Experiência sólida em engenharia de plataformas , DevOps  ou SRE . Conhecimento prático em cloud computing  (AWS, GCP ou Azure). Domínio de Linux  e redes, com foco em segurança e alta disponibilidade. Habilidade para escrever scripts e automações em Python , Go  ou Bash . Mentalidade colaborativa e foco em resolver problemas de forma criativa e sustentável.  ❗Idioma: Espanhol avançado – Requisito obrigatório.  Onde você vai trabalhar?  No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.
